title: Attendance
intro: Track clock times and build schedules so labor hours stay accurate for payroll and reporting.

sections.title: Attendance records
steps: Open the Attendance tab.
Review clock-in and clock-out events for staff.
Correct or approve exceptions when your role allows.
sections.caption: Attendance tab.

sections.title: Scheduling
sections.intro: Schedules plan who works which shifts.
steps: Open the Scheduling tab.
Build or adjust shifts for upcoming days.
Published schedules guide floor staffing and attendance expectations.
sections.caption: Scheduling tab.

sections.title: Manual attendance entry
sections.intro: Correct missing punches or backfill time when terminals were unavailable.
steps: On Attendance tab click Manual entry.
Select employee and enter clock-in and clock-out datetimes.
Add notes and save — hours feed payroll and reports.
sections.caption: Manual attendance entry modal.

fields.name: Employee
fields.effect: Whose time record is being created or corrected.

fields.name: Clock in
fields.effect: Start of the worked interval.

fields.name: Clock out
fields.effect: End of the worked interval; must be after clock in.

fields.name: Notes
fields.effect: Reason for manual entry on audit trail.

sections.title: Work schedule form
sections.intro: A schedule is a named date range containing draft or published shifts.
steps: Open Scheduling and add a schedule.
Set name, period start, and period end.
Add shifts or generate from templates while status is draft.
sections.caption: Work schedule form.

fields.name: Name
fields.effect: Label for the schedule period (e.g. Week 12).

fields.name: Period start
fields.effect: First datetime covered by the schedule.

fields.name: Period end
fields.effect: Last datetime covered by the schedule.

sections.title: Scheduled shift form
sections.intro: Assigns one employee to a time block within a draft schedule.
steps: From a draft schedule click Add shift.
Pick work schedule, employee, and start/end times.
Optionally apply shift template, department, position, and cost center.
Save — conflicts warn if overlaps exist.
sections.caption: Scheduled shift form.

fields.name: Work schedule
fields.effect: Parent schedule that must be in draft to edit.

fields.name: Employee
fields.effect: Staff assigned to the shift.

fields.name: Shift template
fields.effect: Optional preset from Admin → Users → Shifts.

fields.name: Department / position / cost center
fields.effect: Override org tags for this shift.

fields.name: Start at / end at
fields.effect: Scheduled clock window.

sections.title: Schedule template form
sections.intro: Reusable weekly pattern used to bulk-generate shifts.
steps: Open Templates under Scheduling.
Name the template and pick weekdays with start/end times.
Optionally link shift template and org defaults.
Save for use with Generate schedule.
sections.caption: Schedule template form.

fields.name: Name
fields.effect: Template label in generate dialog.

fields.name: Days of week
fields.effect: Which weekdays receive shifts.

fields.name: Start / end time
fields.effect: Daily shift window applied on selected days.

fields.name: Break minutes
fields.effect: Unpaid break duration subtracted from scheduled hours.

fields.name: Shift template
fields.effect: Links to POS shift definition for reporting.

sections.title: Generate schedule from template
steps: Click Generate on Scheduling.
Select draft work schedule and template.
Multi-select employees to receive generated shifts.
Generate — creates shifts, skipping conflicts where configured.
sections.caption: Generate schedule dialog.

fields.name: Work schedule
fields.effect: Target draft schedule receiving new shifts.

fields.name: Template
fields.effect: Weekly pattern defining days and times.

fields.name: Employees
fields.effect: Staff who each get a copy of the template shifts.

sections.title: Shift swap request
steps: Click Request swap on Scheduling.
Select the scheduled shift and requesting employee.
Optionally name a target employee and proposed swap shift.
Submit — creates a pending swap for manager approval.
sections.caption: Shift swap request form.

fields.name: Scheduled shift
fields.effect: Shift the requester wants to give up or exchange.

fields.name: Requesting employee
fields.effect: Employee initiating the swap.

fields.name: Target employee
fields.effect: Optional coworker to take or exchange the shift.

fields.name: Proposed shift
fields.effect: Optional counter-shift offered in exchange.
